card.name: Journal citation volume spots and 'need of'
card.fires_on: The gap, punctuation or abbreviation right after a journal name or year in a reference list, just before the volume or page number. Also the word 'need' in older phrasing like 'need of' or 'need not'.

modes.label: Citation punctuation
modes.description: Space, period or semicolon after a journal title or year, just before volume and page numbers.

modes.label: The word need
modes.description: 'Need' used as a noun or verb in formal older prose, as in 'need of' or 'need not'.
modes.example: There was<< need>> of help from the nation.”

card.plain: It marks the spot in a reference entry where the volume or page number comes next, and also the word 'need' in old-style prose.
